key_insight: This review organizes robot-mounted vision-based post-weld inspection into three processing levels and three deep-learning routes toward automated quality assessment.
engineering_relevance: Vision-based robotic inspection could reduce reliance on manual judgment and support online closed-loop quality control in welding production lines.
method: Structures visual inspection as preprocessing, defect recognition and segmentation, and quality diagnosis.
Reviews defect classification, 3D weld geometry measurement, and multimodal temporal diagnosis.
Compares CNN, YOLO, U-Net, and DETR applications and examines industrial interference factors.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a technical review but reports no datasets, quantitative benchmarks, or production-line validation results.
watch_item: Reliable deployment requires robustness to industrial interference; online closed-loop performance is not demonstrated in the abstract.
paper_title: A Review of Post-weld Inspection Technology
